'''Wol Cabasshites''' were a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] of sedentary, [[limb]]less beings that sported a long [[tongue]]<ref name="VE" /> from [[Wol Cabassh]].<ref name="Geektionary" /> Because of their appearance, they were frequently mistaken for pests. At the [[time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War]], a Wol Cabasshite named [[Ghoel]]<ref name="VE" /> resided in the [[Boba Fett's Palace|palace]] of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], glued to the walls and arches. The [[mollusk]]-like being possessed a prehensile tongue as long as his body, which he used to lick courtiers.<ref name="Geektionary" /> He was present when [[C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2]] arrived to deliver a message from [[Luke Skywalker]].<ref name="Episode VI" />
